title: Geometry of non-Hermitian Yang--Mills moduli spaces
summary: We study the moduli space of non-Hermitian Yang--Mills connections over a compact Kähler manifold. Using normalized harmonic metrics, we construct a natural Hermitian metric on the unobstructed locus and show that, near the Hermitian locus, the unobstructed locus carries an almost hypercomplex structure which is compatible with the associated Riemannian metric.
